decisive_items: continuous diffuse granular and friable mucosa to the ascending colon
Moderately active colitis with cryptitis and crypt abscesses
Clostridium difficile toxin was not present
response.rationale: Endoscopic continuous colonic involvement from rectum to ascending colon with granular friable mucosa and biopsy showing cryptitis/abscesses are classic for ulcerative colitis, more specific than generic IBD. Negative C. diff toxin excludes infectious colitis.

rejected.why: C. difficile toxin absent, contradicting diagnosis
Hunger strike context is nonspecific and does not explain endoscopic/biopsy findings
Ischemic colitis typically lacks continuous mucosal granularity and crypt abscesses; imaging normal
